budget_measurement_definition.statement: The registered ceiling is measured in actively used GPU-hours. VM wall-clock hours and allocated GPU-hours are reported separately and are not bound by that ceiling.

actively_used_gpu_hours.definition: GPU-seconds actually consumed by work this invocation performed, from the per-step gpu_seconds field of the journal, divided by 3600
actively_used_gpu_hours.note: each shard occupied exactly one physical A100 for its own wall time, so actively used GPU-seconds is the sum across shards rather than the maximum

cumulative.source: sum of gpu_seconds over studies/study5/qualification-eq*/journal/*.jsonl divided by 3600

vm_wall_clock_hours.definition: elapsed hours during which each VM was in the running power state
vm_wall_clock_hours.note: accrues by operator decision; measured and reported, never used to argue for stopping anything
vm_wall_clock_hours.a100_vm_uptime_at_measurement: 2 days 15 hours 36 minutes, unchanged by this phase
vm_wall_clock_hours.cpuserver_hours_this_invocation: running throughout; not used by this phase
vm_wall_clock_hours.training_group_v100_hours_this_invocatio: running throughout; not used, not reached, not configured

allocated_gpu_hours.definition: visible GPU count multiplied by the hours each GPU host was running
allocated_gpu_hours.note: all four A100s were occupied for the measurement, so allocated and actively used are close here; they are still reported separately because OD-001 forbids substituting one for the other

training_group_v100.note: these are required to remain running, remain idle and remain untouched; their correct role in this study is to stay unchanged, and they did

claim_ceiling: A resource record. It licenses no claim of any kind.
